intervention_linkage: Simulated interventions only: files are labelled by stimulation type (SEEG-contact stimulation vs TI stimulation) and monitor (SEEG vs EEG). The stimulation parameters and generating model parameters live in the reserved notebooks/spreadsheets and were not opened. No clinical intervention or outcome linkage exists (virtual patients).
eligibility: Virtual patients only. Per protocol A0001: P2 = held-out test patient (P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz), P1 = development/qualification only. The connectomes/gains are reported by the authors to derive from patient imaging (not verified here); no identifiable data present in opened files.
cohort_overlap: Same two virtual patients appear across all 8 npz files (P1: shared SC sha256 prefix 4073b5ab10d2; P2: e3e2dc9f3efa). All derivatives belong to study family wang2025-vbt-stimulation and are not independent subjects. Overlap with other public cohorts not assessed.
